prompt.alinti: Hermes agent just got its own computer! And the plugin is free! It's called CuaSpaces.
Here's the problem. Right now, Hermes works on your laptop. So it keeps asking, can I run this? Can I delete that? And you sit there clicking yes, yes, yes.
One, every job gets a fresh computer and it's thrown away when it's done.
Two, you can watch it work live and grab the mouse anytime.
And three, it can be any computer you want. Even that old Mac mini in your drawer.
If something breaks, it breaks in a computer that's about to be deleted anyway.
If you want the setup, comment spaces and I'll send it to you.

yontem.ne: Hermes Agent için ayrı bir izole çalışma ortamı sağlayan MIT lisanslı plugin.
